new_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_breadth_pending_id_v2 ON astra_rpc_test_bd83a7001969_plans.backfill_tasks_v2 USING hash (id) WHERE ((family = 'D03'::text) AND (lower(provider) = 'derived'::text))

CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_minute_pending_id_v2 ON astra_rpc_test_bd83a7001969_plans.backfill_tasks_v2 USING hash (id) WHERE ((family = ANY (ARRAY['P01'::text, 'P02'::text])) AND (kind = ANY (ARRAY['retained_reuse'::text, 'alpaca_stock_bars'::text])) AND (COALESCE((scope ->> 'timeframe'::text), '1Min'::text) = '1Min'::text))
